$comment: Non-secret run configuration for the single fixed configuration (config_id=agent). Secrets live in .env.

model.$comment: Exact id confirmed from GET https://litellm.oit.duke.edu/v1/models on 2026-11-08 (requires Duke network/VPN).
model.name: GPT 4.1 Mini

pricing.$comment: USD per 1M tokens, used only when the x-litellm-response-cost header is missing. Matches GPT-4.1 mini list pricing; verified 2026-11-09 against gateway header costs (108 uncached + 16384 cached in, 23 out -> $0.0017184).

rate_limit.$comment: Duke gateway per-key limits read from X-Ratelimit-Limit-* headers on 2026-11-09. 429s wait Retry-After (else default_wait_s) up to max_429_retries times; batches wait for the window between attempts.

budget.$comment: Pilot values. Enforced by the controller; model output cannot change them.

path_remap.$comment: NTFS cannot hold '?'; the directory is extracted byte-identically from the pinned commit.
